1.

God in grace the His own chose And from "the distant land" took. He to us gave life and salvation, When He us to the Son drew.

2.

The Father’s counsel soon shall be fulfilled, Sonship He already has bestowed, All He has said shall be wholly accomplished, All shall appear as He has purposed.

3.

We admire here His love, Which so high and deep is shown. Christ is God’s power and wisdom, Life in abundance He gives.

4.

Lord Jesus, soon Thou comest, All Thy grace we shall behold, Not in part alone, nay, its fullness. Then shall we clearly understand.

5.

Thee we await, Lord Jesus, Thou our true hope now art. The creation in bondage sigheth, Freedom soon Thou to it wilt impart.

6.

This world, where Thou hast walked, Also we now pass through. Fix our gaze on Thee more and more, Till Thy blissful home we attain.
